oid4vp-mdoc-verifier.target: Marty's public verifier URL through the gateway

upstream_fixture_review.policy: Keep executing the exact unmodified runner and retain the failure as visible upstream evidence. Never replace the runner certificate, alter validation time, bypass certificate-profile validation, add an expected failure, modify the imported suite, or exclude the lane. Adopt and rerun the first reviewed upstream release that fixes work item 1891.
